tagline: Your Trusted Partner in Life Insurance & Real Estate
profilePictureAlt: Flor Arcilla, licensed insurance agent and real estate sales associate
bio: With over 10 years of experience serving families and investors across the region, I combine deep insurance expertise with a sharp eye for real estate opportunities. Whether you are protecting what matters most or finding your next home or investment property, I am here to guide you every step of the way.
richTextAbout:
I started my career in financial services because I believe that security and smart investment go hand in hand. After a decade in insurance—helping families protect their income, health, and future, I expanded into real estate, where I now help buyers, sellers, and investors make confident decisions in any market.

My dual licence is more than a credential. It means I can sit across the table from you and see your situation through two lenses at once: what do you need to protect today, and how can your property work harder for your tomorrow?

Outside the office, I volunteer with a local housing-assistance non-profit and serve as a mentor for newly licenced agents in our district. Healthy living comes first, hence I am an avid exercise enthusiast.

servicesPageHero.heading: Protect What Matters. Own What You Deserve.
servicesPageHero.subCopy: Whether you're here or abroad, I will help you protect your family and own your dream home with the right plan, the right property, and a trusted partner by your side.

services.title: Traditional Insurance
services.description: Protect the people who matter most with term, whole life, and endowment plans designed to give you solid, reliable coverage. Whether you need short-term financial protection or lifetime security, these plans ensure your loved ones are covered no matter what happens — with optional benefits you can customize as your life evolves.

services.title: Insurance With Investment
services.description: Why choose between protection and growing your wealth? With variable unit-linked (VUL) plans, your premium is split between life insurance coverage and investment funds — so you stay protected while your money works toward your medium- to long-term financial goals. Ideal for building a fund for your family's future, your child's education, or your own retirement.

services.title: Health Insurance
services.imageAlt: Health insurance coverage for individuals and families
services.description: Stay financially protected against the high cost of hospitalization, critical illness, and medical emergencies. With individual and family health plans covering cancer, heart attack, stroke, and more, you can focus on getting better instead of worrying about the bills. Plans can be shared across family members for broader protection.

services.title: Pre-Selling Properties
services.imageAlt: Blueprint and scale model of a pre-selling property
services.description: Get in early and lock in the best price before a property is built. Pre-selling units offer lower introductory rates, flexible payment terms, and the opportunity to grow your investment as the property appreciates upon turnover. I guide you through unit selection, reservations, and the full buying process from day one.

services.title: Ready For Occupancy (RFO)
services.description: Want to move in right away? RFO properties are fully built and ready for turnover — no waiting, no uncertainty. I help you find the right house and lot or condo unit that matches your budget, lifestyle, and location preferences so you can start your next chapter without delay.

services.title: Home Buying Assistance
services.description: Buying your first home — or your next one — is a big deal, and you shouldn't have to figure it out alone. From finding the right property and computing for monthly amortization, to processing bank or Pag-IBIG financing, I walk you through every step so you can make a confident, informed decision.

services.title: Property Investment
services.description: Real estate remains one of the most reliable investments in the Philippines. Whether you're looking to buy and hold, earn through rental income, or diversify your portfolio, I help you identify high-growth areas and properties with strong appreciation potential — including ProFriends' integrated township developments.

services.title: OFW Property Assistance
services.description: Living or working abroad doesn't have to stop you from investing back home. I specialize in helping OFWs secure their dream property remotely — from virtual tripping and online reservations to processing Pag-IBIG OFW loans and coordinating with family representatives here in the Philippines.

services.title: Financing & Loan Assistance
services.description: Not sure which payment scheme works best for you? I help you explore and compare all available options — Pag-IBIG Fund (HDMF), bank financing, or in-house installment plans. I assist with documentary requirements, loan applications, and computations so the financial side of your purchase is as smooth as possible.

services.title: Property Tripping
services.description: See it before you sign it. I arrange on-site and virtual property tours so you can experience the community, check the actual unit or lot, and feel confident in your decision. From Lancaster New City in Cavite to Profriends' Iloilo projects, I coordinate trips at your schedule — even on weekends.

services.title: After-Sales Support
services.description: My job doesn't end at the sale. I continue to assist you with post-purchase needs — from following up on turnover schedules and title transfers, to coordinating with ProFriends' property management for repairs, community concerns, and account updates through the buyer's portal.

testimonials.name: James & Patricia Holloway
testimonials.text: Flor helped us buy our first home and set up life insurance in the same month. Having one trusted professional coordinate both saved us so much stress. She anticipated every question before we even thought to ask it.

testimonials.name: Robert Chen
testimonials.text: I came to Flor purely for investment property advice. She not only found me a fantastic property below asking price, but flagged that my existing policy had a major coverage gap. Saved me thousands twice over.

testimonials.name: Sandra Reyes
testimonials.text: After my divorce I needed to restructure everything—health plan, life cover, and sell the family home. Flor handled it all with empathy and professionalism. I never felt like just a transaction.

testimonials.name: David & Fiona Park
testimonials.text: Very knowledgeable on both the real estate and insurance sides. Flor helped us sell our condo and roll the proceeds into a new whole-life policy as part of our retirement plan. Responsive and thorough.

testimonials.name: Angela Torres
testimonials.text: I was relocating from out of state and felt completely overwhelmed. Flor sent me a personalised neighbourhood comparison and had my home insurance quote ready on closing day. Incredible service.

testimonials.name: Michael Osei
testimonials.text: Flor helped our small business get group health coverage for six employees at a price we could actually afford. Clear, honest, no pressure. We have already referred three colleagues.
